a.lede: Google's launching an "early experiment" feature on Pixel 11 that lets users delegate local business calls to Gemini, like making a reservation, checking if a product is in stock, or rescheduling an appointment. a.title: Gemini can now call businesses for you so you don’t have to wait on hold

b.lede: Google says the AI-calling feature will first be available to Pixel 11 owners in the U.S. who pay for a Gemini subscription.
b.title: Google tests letting Gemini call businesses for you
